-- VÉRTICE EGRESSOS 360° — FASE 1: FUNDAÇÃO E BASE LONGITUDINAL
-- Migração: 20261111000000_alumni_360_phase1.sql
-- ============================================================
-- Tabelas:
--   vertice_alumni_profiles      — Perfil longitudinal do egresso
--   vertice_alumni_education     — Histórico de cursos e conclusões
--   vertice_alumni_employment    — Histórico profissional
--   vertice_alumni_further_ed    — Formação continuada
--   vertice_alumni_contact_hist  — Histórico de atualizações de contato
--   vertice_alumni_audit_log     — Auditoria de alterações
--   vertice_alumni_config        — Configurações por IES (marcos, canais)
-- ============================================================

-- 1. PERFIL LONGITUDINAL DO EGRESSO
-- Identificador único da pessoa (pode ter múltiplas formações).
-- CPF é identificador auxiliar de conciliação, nunca exposto publicamente.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vertice_alumni_profiles (
  id              uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  -- conciliação
  cpf_hash        text,            -- SHA-256 do CPF normalizado (só dígitos), para dedup sem expor
  -- identificação
  full_name       text NOT NULL,
  social_name     text,
  email           text,
  phone           text,
  preferred_channel text DEFAULT 'email' CHECK (preferred_channel IN ('email','whatsapp','sms','portal','nenhum')),
  -- controle
  contact_verified_at  timestamptz,
  contact_updated_at   timestamptz,
  comm_opt_out    boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,  -- direito de opt-out LGPD
  -- metadados
  source          text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'import' CHECK (source IN ('import','eorbit','api','portal','manual')),
  source_ref      text,           -- referência na fonte (matrícula, ID externo)
  created_at      timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at      timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_alumni_profiles_cpf_hash
  ON vertice_alumni_profiles (cpf_hash) WHERE cpf_hash IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_alumni_profiles_email
  ON vertice_alumni_profiles (email) WHERE email IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_alumni_profiles_name
  ON vertice_alumni_profiles (full_name);

-- 2. HISTÓRICO DE CURSOS E CONCLUSÕES
-- Cada linha é uma formação do egresso em uma IES/curso específico.
-- Um alumni_profile pode ter N education records (múltiplas formações).
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vertice_alumni_education (
  id                uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  profile_id        uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES vertice_alumni_profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  institution_id    uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES vertice_institutions(id),
  course_id         uuid REFERENCES vertice_courses(id),
  -- dados acadêmicos
  enrollment_id     text,          -- matrícula histórica
  modality          text,          -- presencial, semipresencial, EAD
  degree            text,          -- bacharelado, licenciatura, tecnólogo
  admission_year    smallint,
  admission_semester smallint CHECK (admission_semester IN (1, 2)),
  -- status com distinção obrigatória (prompt §4)
  academic_status   text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ativo' CHECK (academic_status IN (
    'ativo','provavel_concluinte','concluinte','integralizado',
    'formado','diplomado','egresso_acompanhado',
    'desistente','transferido','jubilado','cancelado'
  )),
  conclusion_year   smallint,
  conclusion_semester smallint CHECK (conclusion_semester IN (1, 2)),
  graduation_date   date,          -- colação de grau
  diploma_date      date,          -- diplomação
  -- vínculo com e-ORBIT legado (quando existir)
  eorbit_aluno_id   bigint,        -- FK lógica para vertice_eorbit_alunos.id
  eorbit_curso_id   bigint,        -- FK lógica para vertice_eorbit_cursos.id
  -- rastreabilidade
  status_source     text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'import' CHECK (status_source IN ('import','eorbit','api','portal','manual','academico')),
  status_verified   boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  status_verified_at timestamptz,
  created_at        timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at        timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  -- impedir duplicata da mesma matrícula no mesmo curso/IES
  UNIQUE (institution_id, course_id, enrollment_id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_alumni_education_profile
  ON vertice_alumni_education (profile_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_alumni_education_institution
  ON vertice_alumni_education (institution_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_alumni_education_course
  ON vertice_alumni_education (course_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_alumni_education_status
  ON vertice_alumni_education (academic_status);

-- 3. HISTÓRICO PROFISSIONAL
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vertice_alumni_employment (
  id              uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  profile_id      uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES vertice_alumni_profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  -- situação
  employment_status text NOT NULL CHECK (employment_status IN (
    'empregado_clt','servidor_publico','autonomo','empresario',
    'estagiario','freelancer','desempregado','nao_informado','outro'
  )),
  occupation      text,           -- cargo ou função
  sector          text,           -- setor econômico
  field_of_work   text,           -- área de atuação
  employer_name   text,
  -- relação com formação

  education_id    uuid REFERENCES vertice_alumni_education(id),  -- qual formação
  -- temporalidade
  started_at      date,
  ended_at        date,

  -- autodeclarado
  salary_range    text CHECK (salary_range IN (
    'ate_1sm','1_3sm','3_5sm','5_10sm','10_20sm','acima_20sm','nao_informado'
  )),
  location_city   text,
  location_state  text,
  -- fonte e rastreabilidade
  source          text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'portal' CHECK (source IN ('portal','pesquisa','import','manual')),
  reported_at     timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  created_at      timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

  source          text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'portal' CHECK (source IN ('portal','pesquisa','import','manual')),

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vertice_alumni_contact_history (
  id              uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

  purpose         text,           -- pesquisa, convite, atualização, oportunidade
  campaign_ref    text,           -- referência da campanha/pesquisa

-- 9. FUNÇÃO DE DEDUPLICAÇÃO POR CPF_HASH
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION alumni_find_or_create_profile(
  p_cpf_hash text,
  p_full_name text,
  p_email text DEFAULT NULL,
  p_phone text DEFAULT NULL,
  p_source text DEFAULT 'import'
) RETURNS uuid
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_id uuid;
BEGIN
  -- Tenta encontrar por cpf_hash
  IF p_cpf_hash IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT id INTO v_id FROM vertice_alumni_profiles WHERE cpf_hash = p_cpf_hash;
    IF v_id IS NOT NULL THEN
      -- Atualiza contato se mais recente
      UPDATE vertice_alumni_profiles
      SET email = COALESCE(p_email, email),
          phone = COALESCE(p_phone, phone),
          contact_updated_at = CASE WHEN p_email IS NOT NULL OR p_phone IS NOT NULL THEN now() ELSE contact_updated_at END,
          updated_at = now()
      WHERE id = v_id;
      RETURN v_id;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- Cria novo perfil
  INSERT INTO vertice_alumni_profiles (cpf_hash, full_name, email, phone, source)
  VALUES (p_cpf_hash, p_full_name, p_email, p_phone, p_source)
  RETURNING id INTO v_id;

  RETURN v_id;
END;
$$;

-- 10. VIEW consolidada para BI (sem dados pessoais sensíveis)
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vertice_alumni_overview AS
SELECT
  ae.institution_id,
  ae.course_id,
  c.name AS course_name,
  c.modality,
  ae.academic_status,
  ae.conclusion_year,
  ae.conclusion_semester,
  ae.status_verified,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ae.profile_id) AS total_egressos,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ae.profile_id) FILTER (WHERE ap.email IS NOT NULL) AS com_contato_valido,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ae.profile_id) FILTER (WHERE ap.contact_updated_at > now() - interval '12 months') AS contato_atualizado_12m
FROM vertice_alumni_education ae
JOIN vertice_alumni_profiles ap ON ap.id = ae.profile_id
LEFT JOIN vertice_courses c ON c.id = ae.course_id
WHERE ae.academic_status IN ('formado','diplomado','egresso_acompanhado','integralizado','concluinte')
GROUP BY ae.institution_id, ae.course_id, c.name, c.modality,
         ae.academic_status, ae.conclusion_year, ae.conclusion_semester, ae.status_verified;

-- Views BI
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_cpa_campaign_indicators AS
SELECT c.institution_id, c.id AS campaign_id, c.title AS campaign_title, c.target_audience, c.status AS campaign_status,
  COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) AS total_eligible,
  COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) FILTER (WHERE i.status NOT IN ('elegivel')) AS total_invited,
  COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) FILTER (WHERE i.delivered_at IS NOT NULL) AS total_delivered,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'concluido') AS total_completed,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'em_andamento') AS total_in_progress,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'abandonado') AS total_abandoned,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'concluido') / COUNT(DISTINCT i.id), 2) END AS pct_completion
FROM vertice_cpa_campaigns c
LEFT JOIN vertice_cpa_invitations i ON i.campaign_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN vertice_cpa_responses r ON r.campaign_id = c.id AND r.invitation_id = i.id
GROUP BY c.institution_id, c.id, c.title, c.target_audience, c.status;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_cpa_cycle_summary AS
SELECT cy.institution_id, cy.id AS cycle_id, cy.title AS cycle_title, cy.status AS cycle_status,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ca.id) AS campaigns, COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) AS findings,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) FILTER (WHERE f.decision_status = 'deliberado') AS findings_deliberated,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS actions, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) FILTER (WHERE a.status IN ('executada','avaliada')) AS actions_completed,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) FILTER (WHERE a.evidence_url IS NOT NULL) AS actions_with_evidence,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fb.id) AS feedbacks_delivered
FROM vertice_cpa_cycles cy
LEFT JOIN vertice_cpa_campaigns ca ON ca.cycle_id = cy.id
LEFT JOIN vertice_cpa_findings f ON f.cycle_id = cy.id
LEFT JOIN vertice_cpa_actions a ON a.finding_id = f.id
LEFT JOIN vertice_cpa_feedbacks fb ON fb.cycle_id = cy.id
GROUP BY cy.institution_id, cy.id, cy.title, cy.status;

-- 1. Tabela de Objetivos (Goals)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vertice_sdg_goals (
  id smallint PRIMARY KEY,
  code text NOT NULL UNIQUE,        -- '1', '2', ... '17'
  title_en text NOT NULL,            -- título original em inglês
  title_pt text NOT NULL,            -- tradução oficial para português
  icon_color text,                   -- cor oficial do ODS
  source text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UN A/RES/70/1',
  imported_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- 2. Tabela de Metas (Targets)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vertice_sdg_targets (
  id serial PRIMARY KEY,
  goal_id smallint NOT NULL REFERENCES vertice_sdg_goals(id),
  code text NOT NULL UNIQUE,        -- '1.1', '1.2', '1.a', etc.
  title_en text NOT NULL,
  title_pt text,                    -- tradução quando disponível
  is_means_of_implementation boolean DEFAULT false,  -- metas com letra (a, b, c)
  source text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UN A/RES/70/1',
  imported_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- 3. Tabela de vinculação projeto-ODS com fundamentação obrigatória
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vertice_extension_sdg_links (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  institution_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES vertice_institutions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES vertice_extension_projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  target_id int NOT NULL REFERENCES vertice_sdg_targets(id),

  -- Fundamentação obrigatória (plano Impacto exige)
  justification text NOT NULL,        -- por que este projeto se vincula a esta meta
  contribution_type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'produto'
    CHECK (contribution_type IN ('produto', 'resultado', 'impacto_demonstrado')),
  evidence_doc_id uuid,               -- documento de evidência

  linked_by uuid NOT NULL,            -- auth.uid()
  linked_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
  validated_by uuid,                  -- quem validou a vinculação
  validated_at timestamptz,

);

BEGIN;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vertice_extension_participants (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  institution_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES vertice_institutions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES vertice_extension_projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  participant_type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'discente'
    CHECK (participant_type IN ('docente','discente','tecnico','comunidade','externo')),
  name text NOT NULL,
  registration_number text, -- matrícula (discente) ou SIAPE (docente)
  course_id uuid, -- curso do aluno
  hours_assigned int DEFAULT 0, -- horas atribuídas neste projeto
  hours_completed int DEFAULT 0, -- horas efetivamente cumpridas
  role_in_project text, -- coordenador, bolsista, voluntário, monitor
  is_scholarship boolean DEFAULT false, -- bolsista?
  scholarship_value numeric(10,2),
  started_at date,
  ended_at date,
  status text DEFAULT 'ativo' CHECK (status IN ('ativo','concluido','desligado','trancado')),
  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vertice_extension_hour_entries (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  institution_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES vertice_institutions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  project_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES vertice_extension_projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  participant_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES vertice_extension_participants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

  -- Tipo do lançamento
  entry_type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'credit'
    CHECK (entry_type IN ('credit', 'correction', 'reversal')),

  -- Minutos inteiros (positivo = crédito, negativo = estorno/correção)
  minutes int NOT NULL CHECK (minutes != 0),

  -- Evidência e contexto
  description text NOT NULL,
  evidence_doc_id uuid,          -- link para vertice_documents
  activity_date date NOT NULL,    -- data da atividade realizada
  reference_entry_id uuid,        -- para correções: aponta para o lançamento original

  -- Auditoria
  recorded_by uuid NOT NULL,      -- auth.uid() de quem registrou
  recorded_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  approved_by uuid,               -- quem validou (null = pendente)
  approved_at timestamptz,

  -- Constraint: correções devem referenciar um lançamento original
  CONSTRAINT chk_correction_ref CHECK (
    (entry_type = 'credit') OR (reference_entry_id IS NOT NULL)
  )
);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vertice_private.prevent_hour_entry_mutation()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Lançamentos de horas são imutáveis. Use um lançamento de correção ou estorno.';
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_hour_entry_immutable
  BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON vertice_extension_hour_entries
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION vertice_private.prevent_hour_entry_mutation();

 coalesce(f.instrument_indicators,'{}') as indicators,r.id as request_id,r.goal_id,
